mapper.select: SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.ISSUE_AMT, T6.SALE_PERIOD PERIOD, T5.LOAD_RATE*100 LOAD_RATE, T5.INVEST_RATE*100 INVEST_RATE, T4.BUYOUT_RATE*100 BUYOUT_RATE, T2.CASH_ID PRI_CASH_ID, T7.CASH_ID INT_CASH_ID , CASE WHEN COUNT(T9.CASH_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END isPayed FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE = T1.VDATE LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT_BUYOUT_RATE T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T5 ON T5.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T4.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T6 ON T6.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T7.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C01' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8 ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T9 ON T9.CASH_ID = T8.CASH_ID AND T9.MDATE = T8.MDATE AND T9.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and T9.IS_CANCEL = 'N' WHERE T1.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.ISSUE_AMT, T6.SALE_PERIOD, T5.LOAD_RATE, T5.INVEST_RATE, T4.BUYOUT_RATE, T2.CASH_ID, T7.CASH_ID order by T1.VDATE asc,T6.SALE_PERIOD asc
